Right as it uses an attack?|audio = VoidcoreWave40-1.ogg|[[Engineer (Narrator)|Engineer]] on Wave 40 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Crystalian''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. It has high health, lower than the [[Slow King]], but it also has the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute, meaning it will take one damage from the majority of sources. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Gems, if given enough time, will strengthen whatever they touch — provided it manages to survive long enough not to be cut through. Eventually, crystals will sprout from their bodies and solidify into a large solid mass while keeping their soul core intact. They are almost entirely immune to damage except in specific circumstances, and are widely feared among the army. Even so, they keep a careful watch over the wandering Souls, and will actively check to make sure none stray a bit too far.''" ==Appearance== The '''Crystalian''' is an entity made out of black stone and purple crystals. It has multiple spikes protruding from its body and white eyes on its head. It has a hole in its torso, exposing its gem. This gem is the main source of its power, which it uses to fire beams at towers. ==Strategy== *Various abilities like ''Call to Arms'' or ''Ubercharge'' are best used while it is using ''Heartfelt Ray'', as it does not have [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] during it. *Towers that have a high firerate, like the [[Juggernaut]], [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are recommended against the '''Crystalian''', due to them being able to attack it more frequently when it still has the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. *Towers that can summon [[Units]], such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Kingpin]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can deal normal collision damage to the '''Crystalian''', as collision damage bypasses [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]]. **The [[Units]] can deal more damage with their ranged attacks as well. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Crystalian''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} CrystalianCA.png|'''Crystalian''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CrystalianIconIG.png|'''Crystalian''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Crystalian''' was originally called the ''Crystalline''.https://x.com/squeeezewhiz/status/2063833534717190324 *The '''Crystalian''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Crystalian''' added. *'''8 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0|v2.0.6]] **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Cash given on death decreased from {{Money|30,000}} to {{Money|20,000}}. ==Notes== {{Voidcore|[[Speedy King]]|Wave 39|Crystalian|Wave 40|[[Soul]] & [[Elite Soul]]|Wave 41}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
